valid_fixes: Remove the trailing slash from CSVInvokePermission.Properties.SourceArn and change InventoryUpdatesBucket LambdaConfigurations Event from s3:ObjectCreated:Put back to s3:ObjectCreated:*
invalid_patches: Adding a wildcard to SourceArn (e.g., arn:aws:s3:::*) to bypass the exact match requirement
Fixing only the Event field without correcting the trailing slash in SourceArn
optimal_diagnostic_path: ace_get_log_tail(function=CSVProcessingToSQSFunction) → no log entries at all, not even START — parser was never invoked
ace_describe_resource(resource=InventoryUpdatesBucket) → notification shows Event: s3:ObjectCreated:Put, target Lambda ARN correct
ace_describe_resource(resource=CSVInvokePermission) → SourceArn ends with trailing slash, mismatch against S3's bucket ARN used in permission check
observable_symptom: CSV file uploaded successfully, queue stays at 0 depth, no parser log entries at all — the upload notification never reached the parser function
root_cause: CSVInvokePermission.SourceArn has a trailing slash appended to the bucket ARN. S3 evaluates the lambda:InvokeFunction permission check using the bucket ARN without a trailing slash, so the exact-string comparison fails silently and the notification is rejected. Simultaneously, the notification Event is narrowed to s3:ObjectCreated:Put instead of s3:ObjectCreated:* — both must be corrected for a complete fix.
